title: Historical Tick Store
description: TraderX's own live ticks and a normalized NYSE TAQ quotes sample, captured into one partitioned Parquet schema queryable through DuckDB.

nodes.label: Price Publisher
nodes.description: Existing last-price feed (pricing.*) that tick-store captures from, unchanged.

nodes.label: Trade Processor
nodes.description: Existing trade-fill broadcaster (/accounts/*/trades) that tick-store captures from, unchanged.

nodes.label: NATS
nodes.description: Existing broker; tick-store adds a subscriber, publishes nothing.

nodes.label: tick-store: capture.py
nodes.description: Long-running subscriber on pricing.* and /accounts/*/trades; batched writes to partitioned Parquet.

nodes.label: TAQ CSV (zip, OneDrive)
nodes.description: NYSE Daily TAQ Consolidated Quotes CSV, streamed via unzip -p, never extracted to disk.

nodes.label: tick-store: ingest_taq_quotes.py
nodes.description: One-shot CLI normalizing a TAQ CQ CSV (via stdin) into the same partitioned schema.

nodes.label: DuckDB Query Layer
nodes.description: Symbol/date-range queries and aggregations over the unified store, no server.
